originality.rationale: The exact prior example is covered and credited, but its full text expressly does not classify all degree-eight arrangements. Gałecka supplies numerical bounds without the all-arrangements conclusion; Dimca–Pokora classify free arrangements. The new necessary incidence-cycle argument and global uniqueness of the projective orbit have no identified equivalent or stronger precedent; residual priority risk from unindexed treatments is acknowledged.
residual_risks: Unindexed pre-existing classification of the special one-conic/six-line near-free moduli locus could make this result nonoriginal.
